private `VITALIS_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment value. Invalid file configuration
fails closed; it does not fall back to the environment token. Never put tokens

```json
  "properties": {
    "failure_code": {
      "title": "Failure Code",

    "message": {
      "title": "Message",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "next_action": {
      "enum": [
        "correct_request",
        "authenticate",
        "request_scope",
        "check_resource",
        "refresh_and_retry",
        "retry_later",
        "check_service"
      ],
      "title": "Next Action",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "request_id": {
      "title": "Request Id",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "retryable": {
      "title": "Retryable",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "state": {
      "const": "failed",
      "title": "State",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "state",
    "failure_code",
    "message",
    "retryable",
    "next_action",
    "request_id"
  ],
  "title": "APIError",
  "type": "object"
}
```

### #/components/schemas/GoalInput

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Only an explicit confirmation creates an accepted goal.\n\nTraining days and pain fields update the existing TrainingPreferences record.\nIts content fingerprint is required when changing any of those fields.",
  "properties": {
    "aggregation": {
      "default": "mean",
      "enum": [
        "mean",
        "sum",
        "latest"
      ],
      "title": "Aggregation",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "available_training_days": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "maxItems": 7,
          "type": "array"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Available Training Days"
    },
    "comparison": {
      "default": "at_least",
      "enum": [
        "at_least",
        "at_most",
        "equal"
      ],
      "title": "Comparison",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "confirmed": {
      "const": true,
      "title": "Confirmed",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "default": 0,
      "minimum": 0.0,
      "title": "Expected Revision",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "expected_training_preferences_revision": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "maxLength": 64,
          "minLength": 64,
          "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Expected Training Preferences Revision"
    },
    "goal_type": {
      "maxLength": 64,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*$",
      "title": "Goal Type",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "input_event_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "maxLength": 128,
          "minLength": 1,
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Input Event Ref"
    },
    "metric_key": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "maxLength": 64,
          "minLength": 1,
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Metric Key"
    },
    "pain_or_injury_notes": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "maxLength": 500,
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Pain Or Injury Notes"
    },
    "pain_or_injury_status": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "enum": [
            "NONE",
            "PRESENT",
            "UNKNOWN"
          ],
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Pain Or Injury Status"
    },
    "target_date": {
      "format": "date",
      "title": "Target Date",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "target_unit": {
      "maxLength": 24,
      "minLength": 1,
      "title": "Target Unit",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "target_value": {
      "minimum": 0.0,
      "title": "Target Value",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "window_days": {
      "default": 7,
      "maximum": 90.0,
      "minimum": 1.0,
      "title": "Window Days",
      "type": "integer"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "confirmed",
    "goal_type",
    "target_value",
    "target_unit",
    "target_date"
  ],
  "title": "GoalInput",
  "type": "object"
}
```

### #/components/schemas/WorkoutRpe

```json
{
  "description": "User-reported session effort with its original source qualification.",
  "properties": {
    "fetched_at": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "format": "date-time",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Fetched At"
    },
    "observed_at": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "format": "date-time",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Activity start context, not the time the user entered their RPE",
      "title": "Observed At"
    },
    "qualification": {
      "const": "user_reported",
      "default": "user_reported",
      "title": "Qualification",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "source": {
      "title": "Source",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "source_field": {
      "title": "Source Field",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "source_record_id": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Source Record Id"
    },
    "source_scope": {
      "enum": [
        "workout_summary",
        "subjective_feedback"
      ],
      "title": "Source Scope",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "time_basis": {
      "const": "activity_day",
      "default": "activity_day",
      "title": "Time Basis",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "unit": {
      "const": "score_1_10",
      "default": "score_1_10",
      "title": "Unit",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "value": {
      "maximum": 10.0,
      "minimum": 1.0,
      "title": "Value",
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "value",
    "source",
    "source_scope",
    "source_field"
  ],
  "title": "WorkoutRpe",
  "type": "object"
}
```
